critical_code_review_comments: server.py find_conflicts widens conflict dates by ±1 day to catch rest-rule violations from adjacent leaves — good pattern; consider capping to only leaves for personnel that could have filled the failing slot to reduce noise when many personnel share leave on the same date.
Templates apply endpoint blindly reactivates aktif=false personnel from snapshot — acceptable for 'template' semantics but flag in UI (currently only counts are shown).

get_carryover falls back to manual only when NO previous schedule exists; if a July schedule is later generated it silently overrides the manual carryover for August. Consider showing a warning in the UI when both exist.
server.py manual_update inline SLOT_TO_TASK logic duplicates knowledge that lives in scheduler.py TASKS — extract a small helper to avoid drift.
